activity.notes: Julio Argentino Roca returned to the presidency for a second distinct term from 12 October 1898 to 12 October 1904. The intervening out-of-office interval requires a separate ATLAS Activity rather than one continuous span.

sources.title: Julio Argentino Roca-II (1898 - 1904) — Casa Rosada
sources.citation_text: Argentina's Casa Rosada records Julio Argentino Roca's second presidential term as 12 October 1898 to 12 October 1904.
